chunks: We did not give them any scripture to study, nor sent any warner before you.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God did not send a warner or give a book to a specific people before Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as highlighting the 'absence of proof' (adam al-hujjah) for the people of Yemen, distinguishing them from other nations who received prior prophets. It underscores the divine justice in holding them accountable despite the lack of a specific, dedicated messenger sent exclusively to them before the finality of Prophethood, thereby reinforcing the concept of universal guidance through the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family).
